gizmo.title: Nā hoapili
gizmo.description: Hōʻike i nā kānaka ma kekahi faila hoapili ma ke ʻano he mau kāleka kanaka, nā ʻōlelo ʻōlelo ʻia, he papa, a i ʻole he papa helu.

configure.title: Faila hoapili
configure.description: Hoʻouka a koho paha i kekahi faila hoapili .vcf. Heluhelu ʻia kona mau kāleka ma ka polokalamu kele pūnaewele.

configure.title: Hōʻike ma ke ʻano
configure.description: Pehea e hōʻike ai i nā mea i loko o ka faila.

configure.title: Poʻo
configure.description: Hōʻike ʻia ma luna o nā hoapili, a ma ke ʻano he lepili no ka papa.
